data.title: Legend at Damac Hills
data.about:
If you are looking for that perfect and exclusive golf course villa lifestyle in Dubai, here is the latest launch that is ideal for you! Presenting Legend in Damac Hills. 

Choose from 12 different types with 3 – 7 bedroom villas. There are 3 options: Classic, Golf, and Park View. When you live in the Legends, you are living a new course in golf lifestyle. Opulent villas with uninterrupted views of the green golf course of the Trump International Golf Club in Dubai. These homes provide the perfect balance between the peaceful nature-loving lifestyle and the world-class community vibe.

characteristics_module.title: Home is Where Serenity Resides

location_tile.title: Damac Hills Close to Everything
location_tile.description:
Located within Damac Hills, Legend is nestled close to the majority of the city’s most attractive landmarks. Damac Hills is close to Remraam, Mudon, Arabian Ranches, Dubai Sports City as well as Dubai Motor City. Perched on the intersection of Hessa Street and Al Qudra Road, Damac Hills is easily accessible.

  • 06 mins – Mudon
  • 11 mins – Dubai Motor City | Dubai Sports City | Arabian Ranches | Remraam
  • 21 mins – Dubai Marina |Dubai Media City | Mall of Emirates
  • 23 mins – Al Maktoum International Airport
  • 28 mins – Downtown Dubai | Burj Khalifa | Dubai Mall
  • 31 mins – Dubai International Airport
